parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: IDs of Android in Container (AIC) instances.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page **1**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries returned on each page.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The deployment status of the SDG.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens describe-sdg-deployment-status --sdg-id sdg-xxxx --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --deployment-type shared --status success --instance-ids aic-xxxx --region-ids cn-hangzhou --disk-ids d-xxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens DescribeSDGDeploymentStatus --region cn-hangzhou --SDGId 'sdg-xxxx' --Status success --DiskIds '["d-xxxxx"]' --PageSize 10 --RegionIds '["cn-hangzhou"]' --PageNumber 1 --DeploymentType shared --InstanceIds '["aic-xxxx"]'
